name: Caldova
tagline: The operating system for climate infrastructure at continental scale.
positioning: Caldova orchestrates every rooftop unit, technician, and service contract across enterprise HVAC fleets — from dispatch to warranty reconciliation.

hero.h1: Command every unit of climate infrastructure you own.
hero.sub: Caldova unifies dispatch, asset telemetry, and contract economics into one system of record — so a 40,000-rooftop portfolio behaves like a single machine.

features.title: Fleet-wide asset ledger
features.description: Every compressor, coil, and RTU tracked from install date to end-of-life, with warranty windows and refrigerant charge logged against each serial number.

features.title: Autonomous dispatch engine
features.description: Route the right technician to the right site by skill, certification, and drive time — rebalancing thousands of work orders the moment an SLA is at risk.

features.title: Predictive failure signals
features.description: Ingest BAS and sensor telemetry to flag failing equipment weeks ahead, converting emergency truck rolls into scheduled maintenance visits.

features.title: Contract economics engine
features.description: Reconcile labor, parts, and refrigerant against every service agreement automatically — see margin per site, per contract, per technician in real time.

features.title: EPA & F-gas compliance
features.description: Refrigerant tracking, leak-rate reporting, and audit-ready records generated as work happens — no clipboard reconciliation at quarter end.

features.title: Portfolio command view
features.description: A single console spanning every region, subcontractor, and building — built for the VP who owns uptime across a national footprint.

testimonials.quote: We consolidated eleven regional dispatch tools into Caldova in one quarter. Emergency call volume dropped 34% because the platform caught failing units before our tenants did.
testimonials.name: Marianne Delacroix

testimonials.quote: The contract economics engine exposed which service agreements were quietly losing us money. That visibility alone paid for the deployment inside a fiscal year.
testimonials.name: Terrence Okafor

testimonials.quote: Our refrigerant compliance used to be a quarterly fire drill. Now the audit trail assembles itself. Caldova is the closest thing our industry has to an operating system.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman

pricing.blurb: For operators standardizing a single region on one platform.
For multi-region enterprises running fleets at scale.
For continental portfolios with bespoke integration needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Caldova is the system of record for enterprise climate infrastructure — orchestrating fleets that would otherwise run on spreadsheets and hope.
